11 10-05-2024 The District Land Acquisition Officer, Vaishali has filed a counter affidavit specifically indicating the acquisition for the purpose of the road construction, which passes through 12 villages of Anchal Vaishali and 11 villages of Anchal Lalganj.
A tabulation is made with respect to the various stages of the acquisition.
It is stated that every step is taken to expedite the process of land acquisition/disbursement of compensation of 23 villages of Lalganj and Vaishali Anchal.
We record the same and direct the District Land Acquisition Officer, Vaishali to file an on date status report as on the next posting date.
Patna High Court CWJC No.2871 of 2022(11) dt.10-05-2024 2.
The NHAI also shall come forward with their response to the affidavit filed by the District Land Acquisition Officer.

sentences.text: The Additional District Land Acquisition Officer, East Champaran, Motihari has filed the counter affidavit contending that many of the raiyats did not turn up when notice was served on them under Section 3E(1) of the National Highways Act, 1956.
4. It is undertaken that any time, the NHAI requires, the required properties shall be handed over by referring the matter of compensation to the Principal Civil Court of original jurisdiction.
5. The undertaking is recorded and the District Land Acquisition Officer is directed to make the deposit in the Court as is the procedure.
The NHAI also shall liaise with the Additional District Land Acquisition Officer so as to get hand over of the properties.
The Additional District Land Acquisition Officer and the NHAI shall file on date status report on the next date of hearing.
6. The District Land Acquisition Officer, Muzaffarpur has filed a counter affidavit dated 14.03.2024.

It is stated in the counter affidavit that the road construction which is in the Patna High Court CWJC No.2871 of 2022(11) dt.10-05-2024 district is divided in two parts, one in Adalwari-Manikpur Section and the other in Manikpur-Sahebganj Section.
The land of 6 Mauzas and 36 Mauzas comes under acquisition.

In the first section the estimate of compensation under Section 3G of the NH Act,
1956
has been prepared and sent to the NHAI, which has been approved and 24.10 crores have already been disbursed out of the totally claimed 36.57 cores.
Notices have been issued to the land lords for submitting documents for the purpose of payment of compensation.
7. On the second part, the proposal is of 36 Mauzas under Section 3G, totaling Rs.486.78 crores, out of which 403.97 crores has been approved by the NHAI.
Similar notices have been issued and 174.57 crores have already been disbursed.
Insofar as the objections filed by some of the landlords, notices have been issued to the parties.
It is also stated that as of now nobody has come from the NHAI office to expedite the proceedings and the liaisoning work has to be commenced by the NHAI only after the land is ready for handover.
8. The District Land Acquisition Officer, Muzaffarpur shall file an on date status report on the next date of hearing.

9. The learned Additional Advocate General submits Patna High Court CWJC No.2871 of 2022(11)
dt.10-05-2024 that only partial approvals have been made.
However, learned Counsel for the NHAI submits that the cheques for the entire amounts have been deposited.
The District Land Acquisition Officer shall file an affidavit, if any subsequent payments are made of the deficiency.
The NHAI shall also file an affidavit specifically pointing out the amounts deposited, on the next date.
10. The District Land Acquisition Officer, Saran has filed a counter affidavit dated 02.04.2024.
Acquisition has to be carried out in the said district in a total of 25 villages and area to be acquired is 99.2196 hectares.
The 3G approval has been sent for 122 crores.

It is also stated that Rs.
1,15,79,401/- have already been paid.
11. It is stated in the counter affidavit that the Collector, Saran himself is monitoring the acquisition proceedings and disbursement of payment.

13. The District Land Acquisition Officer shall file an Patna High Court CWJC No.2871 of 2022(11)
dt.10-05-2024 on date status report on the next date of hearing.
14. Post the matter on 02.08.2024.
